name: Nami Staffing
description: A calm, photograph-led theme for a people-first recruitment and staffing agency that places people in warehouses, clinics, offices and kitchens: white and pale grey bands, ink text, deep field green for one thin centre line, labels and pill buttons, one terracotta corner label, Lora over Nunito Sans. The home page opens on two documentary photographs either side of a narrow centre column with the opening line and flat corner labels, over an info bar (free for job seekers, hours, phone, address); then the agency in three paragraphs either side of the centre line, two doors for employers and job seekers, the placement from brief to day thirty in five scattered photographs of different sizes, the office in one wide photograph with the founder's words, three consultants in a sliding row, the fees in one plain paragraph on a pale band with a convex arc, the latest notes as a ruled list and an invitation to come in for a coffee. With For employers, For job seekers, How a placement works, Consultants, Fees, About, Notes, Contact and Journal. Sample content in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German.

summary.en: Calm staffing agency theme: two photos around a centre line with corner labels, placements in scattered photos, consultants, plain fees.
summary.zh-TW: 沉穩的人力仲介與派遣主題：中央細線兩側的兩張紀實照片與角標、從需求到到職第 30 天的錯落照片、具名顧問與一段話說清楚的費用。
summary.ja: 落ち着いた人材紹介・派遣会社のテーマ。中央線をはさむ2枚の写真と角ラベル、依頼から入社30日目までの写真、顧問紹介、わかりやすい料金。
summary.fr: Thème sobre pour agence de recrutement et d’intérim : deux photos autour d’une ligne centrale, placements en images, tarifs clairs.
summary.de: Ruhiges Theme für Personaldienstleister: zwei Fotos um eine Mittellinie, Vermittlung in Bildern, benannte Berater, klare Gebühren.
